name: inite-brain
description: Persistent, bitemporal memory for Claude: search, answer from and record facts in your INITE Brain workspace.
long_description: INITE Brain is a knowledge-graph memory. This extension connects Claude Desktop to your Brain workspace with an API key: Claude can search what the workspace remembers, get cited answers, see how a fact changed over time and record new facts — each one traceable to the conversation it came from. The workspace comes from the key, so there is nothing else to configure. If you would rather sign in than paste a key, add https://brain.inite.ai/mcp as a connector instead (Settings → Connectors).

api_key.title: Brain API key
api_key.description: Issue one at https://brain.inite.ai/en/app/keys — it starts with brain_ and is shown once.

base_url.title: Brain base URL
base_url.description: Change only for a self-hosted deployment.
